Topics · Meaning and purpose

With no God, can my life still mean anything?

People without faith live full lives, and no one denies it. What holds meaning once the last witness goes?

Part 1 of 3

﴿أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

Quran · Al-Mu'minun 23:115

Yes, in the sense most people mean. Love is real. Work well done is real. People who believe in nothing live with courage and tenderness, and no one has the right to call their lives empty. So what is the question? Only this: does meaning have to be made by us alone, or was it there to be found? This verse asks: did you think you were made without purpose? Its own answer is no. Here it is set before you to weigh.

A question for you

Where does the meaning in your life come from?

If you sayFrom the people I love.
ThenThat is a real source, and it needs no one's stamp.
If you sayFrom my work and what I leave behind.
ThenThat leads to a question: how long does it last? That comes next.
If you sayI am not sure there is any.
ThenThat is honest, and it is not a fault here. It may be heavier than it looks. Take your time.

Part 2 of 3

﴿أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى﴾

Translation of the meaning

Does man think that he will be left neglected?[1809]

Translator's notes

[1809] i.e., to no end, without responsibility, or without being returned to the Creator for judgement.

Quran · Al-Qiyamah 75:36

Consider the sharper form. We want meaning, and the universe says nothing. Camus called that collision the absurd and refused both despair and religion: one must imagine Sisyphus happy. That is a brave answer. Notice what it grants: the hunger is real. People can't stop wanting meaning. This verse asks whether a person really thinks he will be left to wander without purpose. It does not speak of hunger, but its question bears on it: is the hunger a pointer? A hunger is not proof of food.

A question for you

What do you make of the desire for meaning?

If you sayA side effect of evolution.
ThenThat is possible. The question is whether knowing that changes what you do each morning.
If you sayA pointer to something larger.
ThenThat fits the verse's question, and it is not proved here.
If you sayI don't know, but I live by it.
ThenThat may be the truest thing many people can say.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ٧ وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ٨﴾

Translation of the meaning

So whoever does an atom's weight[1965] of good will see it, And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.

Translator's notes

[1965] Or "the weight of a small ant."

Quran · Az-Zalzalah 99:7-8

Translation

For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.

Original · Hebrew

כִּ֤י אֶת־כָּל־מַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים יָבִ֥א בְמִשְׁפָּ֖ט עַ֣ל כָּל־נֶעְלָ֑ם אִם־ט֖וֹב וְאִם־רָֽע׃

Ecclesiastes · 12:14

World English Bible

One day the last person who remembers your kindness will be gone. If nothing holds what was done, is it all finally equal: the cruelty and the care, the one who hid a stranger and the one who betrayed him? Many answer that it mattered then, and that is enough. That answer has dignity. These verses answer otherwise: nothing is lost, not an atom's weight of good or evil. You may take that as hope, or as a wish. It is at least a clear alternative.

A question for you

Does something have to last in order to matter?

If you sayNo. It mattered when it happened.
ThenThat is a noble answer, and it accepts what follows from it.
If you sayI don't know, and that troubles me.
ThenThat is an honest unease. It carries the question further.
If you sayYes. I wish there were a reckoning.
ThenMany wish it, victims above all. A wish is not proof, and it is not nothing.
